newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up on Chicago rise.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up on Chicago rise.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market picked up this afternoon on a firmer Chicago soymeal futures opening, market sources said.

"After yesterday's sharp fall on beneficial weather to the U.S. soybeaan crop calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening for a technical recovery sparked operators to buy some nearby material on the dip," one broker said.

Afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $285 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Ghent. Spot Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $273 a tonne fob Rotterdam, afloat at $269 and June at $266 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
